subject: english
title: Unit 6 Opener
subtitle: Wonders of the Sea — a harbor seal in a California kelp forest, and a first look at the three layers of the ocean.

content: Look closely at the opener photo and describe its details.
Name six things in the photo: a seal, whiskers, flippers, kelp, seaweed, underwater.
Meet the big idea of the unit — the three layers of the ocean.
language: Use the academic words describe, details, predict and caption.
Write a caption for the photo using at least two of the six new words.
Predict what the unit will teach, and keep the prediction to check at the end.
